text_block_list.text:
Stopping by the cafeteria one afternoon,
I see
Kawakami Princess, Хиши Акэбоно,
and Mayano
Top Gun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Buono Cooking Class! ☆
Today,
we'll be making a cake!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
First, we'll need to slice the carrots into
chunks
small enough for the blender. ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
On it, chef! Now let's see, where's the
knife...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I can't find it. Do you think it's
being
washed?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Seems like it. But I really don't want to
sit around
and wait, so...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: This'll be quicker! HYAH!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: BAM, BAM, BAM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: WHOA! You're on fire, Kawakami!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And those are some perfectly sized
pieces!
Buono! ☆
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
The batter is ready! Time to pour it into
the mold!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Chef Bono, I think a heart mold would
be best! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
All right! ☆ Let's go with a heart! Sooo,
here's the
mold...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: ...Oh dear. Hmmm, it's a little dented.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. This won't make a
beautiful
heart at all!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Don't fret. We just need to fix the part
that's out
of shape.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Like this...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
HOOHAAAAH!
Ta-dah!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: CLINK!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whaaa?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's just like new! Your method was
quite
unorthodox, but very buono!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Okay, time to bake! I'll preheat the
oven! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Set the temperature to... Huh? The oven
light
won't turn on. Maybe it's broken?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: No way! We've come so far!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no need to worry. Maruzen told
me a good
wallop can fix any broken
machine.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: What?! Is that really true?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That can't be safe. Just hold on for a
second,
Kawak—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Time for my BODY SLAM!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: CRASH! BANG! SLAM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Be carefuuul!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Каваками Принцесс splits the oven in two
with her
attack. The shockwave sends
kitchenware
tumbling to the floor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What the heck are you all doing in
there?! That's
extremely dangerous!
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text: Whoops!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, Kawakami! Maya and
I
finished the cake! How about we eat it

together? ☆
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I got banned from the
kitchen... I'm
sorry I couldn't finish
cooking with you both.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
A princess should not always rely on her

strength... I'm terribly sorry.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
